channel.title: 3ABN Christmas Special
channel.desc: Enter this sacred season with Danny and Yvonne Shelton as they welcome a gifted team of musicians-Tim Parton, Reggie & Ladye Love Smith, Dave Cleveland, and Matt Pearson-for a Christmas worship experience rich with meaning and artistry. From joyful carols including Joy to the World and Angels We Have Heard on High to tender selections like Welcome to Our World, There's No Place Like Home, and The Prayer, each song lifts our hearts toward the Prince of Peace.
